title: Multimodality
tagline: The question arrives as a photo, a PDF or a voice.
story: The question no longer comes as clean text. It arrives as a phone photo of a chart, a scanned manual or a caller who pauses to think. Every modality adds a token bill, a parsing choice and a new way to smuggle in instructions or personal data.
oneLiner: Price the pixels, pick a reader, index what the page shows, choose a voice architecture and treat every image as untrusted input.
youWillLearn: Predict image token cost with the patch and tile formulas and choose a detail level
Choose between layout extraction, Document Intelligence, Content Understanding and a vision LLM
Compare verbalizing, single-vector embeddings and ColPali-style page-image retrieval, with storage numbers
Choose a voice architecture and tune turn detection, transports and audio cost
Defend image safety: hidden instructions, PII in image text and accessibility
Label each product claim with its status and the date you checked it

flashcards.front: What is the default `detail` for image input, and what values exist?
flashcards.back: `auto` is the default. Values are `low`, `high`, `original` and `auto`, and support depends on the model. `low` does not always use fewer tokens than `high`.

flashcards.front: How do patch-based image tokens work?
flashcards.back: patches = ceil(w/32) x ceil(h/32) after fitting the detail limit and patch budget. Tokens = ceil(patches x multiplier). The multiplier is 1.2 for current GPT-5.x models.

flashcards.front: How do tile-based image tokens work for gpt-4o and gpt-4.1?
flashcards.back: `low` costs the 85 base tokens. `high` fits 2048 px, scales the short side to 768 and adds 170 per 512 px tile. A 1024 x 1024 image is 765 tokens (derived).

flashcards.front: What are the OpenAI image request limits?
flashcards.back: 512 MB payload, 1,500 images per request and 30,000 patches per image. Larger images are rejected, not resized. Azure's older vision page lists 20 MB and 10 images.

flashcards.front: When is `detail: original` the right choice?
flashcards.back: Dense, small or spatially sensitive images such as OCR targets and computer use, where the model supports it. The image can still be resized, so map coordinates back.

flashcards.front: Which tool fits standard invoices or receipts?
flashcards.back: A Document Intelligence prebuilt model. Contracts suit Content Understanding. Layout only suits CU `prebuilt-read` or `prebuilt-layout`. On premises needs Document Intelligence containers.

flashcards.front: Which Content Understanding API version is for production on 2026-10-13?
flashcards.back: GA `2025-11-01`. `2026-06-01-preview` adds agentic mode, in-page segmentation, signature detection and document metadata, and has no SLA.

flashcards.front: How does the Content Understanding video analyzer sample video?
flashcards.back: About 1 frame per second at 512 x 512 px. Only speech is transcribed. Segmentation spends generative tokens even with no fields defined.

flashcards.front: What are the two image paths in Azure AI Search?
flashcards.back: Verbalize with the GenAI Prompt skill (one LLM call per image, citable text) or embed directly with Azure Vision or AML (no LLM at index time, image queries, no reasons).

flashcards.front: What is ColPali and what does it cost in storage?
flashcards.back: A VLM embeds page images into multi-vector late-interaction embeddings (MaxSim). About 257.5 KB per page versus 8.6 KB for BGE-M3, roughly 30 times more.

flashcards.front: Why do Azure Vision embedding scores mislead?
flashcards.back: Relevance scores do not compare across queries, and vectors from different model versions are not comparable. Vectors have 1,024 dimensions.

flashcards.front: Chained pipeline or speech-to-speech: when chained?
flashcards.back: When you must inspect, redact or log text between stages, or reuse a text agent. Speech-to-speech wins when low latency matters most.

`server_vad` is silence based, tunable with `threshold`, `prefix_padding_ms` and `silence_duration_ms`. `semantic_vad` classifies the words, with `eagerness` low, medium, high or auto (auto equals medium).

flashcards.front: How is realtime audio billed in tokens?
flashcards.back: User audio is 1 token per 100 ms and assistant audio 1 token per 50 ms. The whole conversation is resent each turn, so later turns cost more.

flashcards.front: Azure realtime transport latency and session cap?
flashcards.back: About 100 ms for WebRTC, about 200 ms for WebSocket, SIP varies. Sessions end at 60 minutes. Use the GA `/openai/v1` endpoint with no `api-version`.

flashcards.front: Do PII and safety tools read text inside images?
flashcards.back: Native document PII redaction does not support digital images with embedded text. Prompt Shields coverage of image text was not verified. OCR first, then run text controls.

flashcards.front: What does OWASP say about hidden instructions in images?
flashcards.back: They are a named multimodal injection risk, and reliable defenses are open research. Treat text read from images as untrusted input.

flashcards.front: What are the Content Safety image API limits?
flashcards.back: 4 MB, 50 x 50 to 7,200 x 7,200 px, in JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF or WEBP. The multimodal API is preview, with text up to 1K characters.

glossary.def: The `detail` image parameter: `low`, `high`, `original` or `auto`. It controls resizing and so token cost and accuracy.
A 32 px by 32 px square. Patch-based models cover the image with patches and multiply the count by a model multiplier.
A 512 px square used by tile-based models, which charge base tokens plus tokens per tile.
Using an LLM to describe an image or figure as text, so it can be embedded, searched and cited.
Scoring with many vectors per item and summing the best match for each query vector (MaxSim), as in ColBERT and ColPali.
A page-image retriever that embeds each page with a vision-language model into multi-vector embeddings.
A benchmark for visually rich document retrieval, introduced with ColPali.
An Azure service with analyzers for documents, images, audio and video. GA API version `2025-11-01`.
One model takes audio in and returns audio out, without text stages in between.
Speech-to-text, then a text agent, then text-to-speech. Text can be inspected between stages.
Azure's managed speech-to-speech service that bundles recognition, model and synthesis.
Turn detection that classifies the words to judge whether the speaker finished, with an `eagerness` setting.
Hidden instructions placed in an image or audio that alter model behavior.

claims.text: OpenAI image requests allow up to 512 MB total payload, 1,500 images and 30,000 patches per image, and images over 30,000 patches are rejected, not resized.
The `detail` parameter defaults to auto in both the Responses API and Chat Completions.
Patch models compute ceil(w/32) x ceil(h/32) patches and multiply by 1.2 for gpt-5.x; a 1024 x 1024 image at high is 1,229 tokens and 2048 x 2048 is 3,000.
For gpt-4o and gpt-4.1 the tile rule uses 85 base tokens and 170 per tile, and low detail costs only the base tokens.
On the gpt-5.4 family, low uses a 2048 px and 6,144 patch budget and can use more tokens than high.
The Azure vision chat page lists 20 MB maximum image size and 10 images per call.
Content Understanding GA API is 2025-11-01, and 2026-06-01-preview adds agentic mode, in-page segmentation, signature detection and document metadata.
Document Intelligence containers are the only on-premises or air-gapped option, and v4.0 GA is 2024-11-30 with no forced migration.
A Document Intelligence custom model needs as few as 5 labeled samples.
The Content Understanding video analyzer samples about 1 frame per second at 512 x 512 px, transcribes only speech, and segmentation spends generative tokens even with no fields.
Azure AI Search verbalizes images with the GenAI Prompt skill (one LLM call per image) or embeds them directly with the Azure Vision or AML skill (no LLM at index time).
Image descriptions in the Content Understanding skill need REST 2026-05-01-preview, and new skillsets should use that skill instead of the Document Layout skill.
Azure Vision multimodal embeddings have 1,024 dimensions and relevance scores cannot be compared across queries.
ColPali needs about 257.5 KB per page versus 8.6 KB for BGE-M3, and ColQwen2 caps patches at 768 and adds 5.3 nDCG@5 over ColPali.
Cohere embed-v4.0 offers dimensions 256, 512, 1024 or 1536 (default), and embed-v5.0-pro and -fast offer up to 2048 (default).
Realtime audio costs 1 token per 100 ms of user audio and 1 token per 50 ms of assistant audio, and the full conversation is resent each turn.
session.truncation.retention_ratio defaults to 1.0, and 0.8 drops extra items to keep the cache valid longer.
Turn detection offers server_vad (silence based) or semantic_vad with eagerness low, medium, high or auto, where auto equals medium.
gpt-live-transcribe and gpt-realtime-whisper need turn detection omitted or null and a manual input_audio_buffer.commit.
Azure realtime lists about 100 ms for WebRTC and about 200 ms for WebSocket, a 60 minute maximum session, and the /openai/v1 endpoint with no api-version.
Voice Live offers over 140 speech-to-text locales and over 600 standard voices.
Foundry voice-based agents are preview and offer no direct SIP.
In Foundry voice agents the interim response latency_threshold_ms defaults to 2000.
The Content Safety image API accepts up to 4 MB and 50 x 50 to 7,200 x 7,200 px, and the multimodal API is preview with text up to 1K characters.
Prompt Shields takes a prompt up to 10K characters and up to five documents totalling 10K characters, and Foundry guardrails moderate the first 1,000 characters of text.
Native document PII redaction supports .txt, .pdf and .docx, and digital images with embedded text are not supported.
OWASP names hidden instructions in images as a multimodal injection risk and says reliable defenses are an open research area.
